args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Use config.publicUrl or config.baseUrl instead of process.env.PUBLIC_URL directly, falling back to the configured public URL rather than hardcoding localhost:3000 in the notification templates.
args.title: Use configured public URL instead of localhost in password reset emails
